generator.instruction: pick up the red block and put it on the green pad

perception.landing_pad: given in the task frame, not detected

physics.snapshot: mjSTATE_INTEGRATION + model.site_pos, restored before every candidate

success_definition.rule: max lift above threshold, final target distance within the radius, and for a block destination the object resting on top of it
success_definition.aborting_candidate: an abort() candidate never executes and is never a success

oracle_definition.note: hidden offline answer key computed after executing every candidate from the restored snapshot; not a deployable verifier

fitted_on.splits: train/val of the world-model dataset, never the pool split

selector_protocol.ranking_is_read_only: candidates are fingerprinted before and after every call
selector_protocol.prefix_faithful: a selector at N sees only the first N candidates
selector_protocol.physics_seed_blind: one block per (pool, prefix), reused across paired physics seeds
